preferredWrite.decision: Find or Create Label by displayName: Wix returns the existing label of that name (newLabel false) or creates it, so a retry, resume or unknown outcome resends the same call. The crosswalk target is label.tagId, the V5 contact private-tag id; label.key is kept as evidence. Read back by key (GET /contacts/v4/labels/{key}).

fallbacks.when: Use for source segmentation rules that are not contact labels.

pitfalls.summary: Do not collapse dynamic segments or marketing automation state into static labels without review.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-27 : a V4 label is the V5 contact private tag. Find or Create Label returns label.tagId (5 chars, e.g. 'WCjva'); V5 tags.privateTags.tagIds takes that tagId, not the label key (a key is refused: 'expected 5 or less'). V4 shows the tag back in info.labelKeys.
A label already on the target with the same displayName is adopted (newLabel false), not duplicated. Two source tags with the same name share one Wix label.

mappingGuidance: Dependencies: no other modeled record must exist first; labels are standalone CRM objects and are written before crm/contact-label puts them on contacts.

Write label definitions with findOrCreateContactLabel; put them on contacts with crm/contact-label (assignContactLabels), never inside the contact upsert body (the default OVERWRITE upsert replaces a matched contact's existing tags).

evidence.note: Find or Create Label: returns the label with this name or creates it; newLabel says which
Verified live: create + query-back readback, safe mode on — 3/3 labels (MailPoet segments) created and read back
